strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Pilih semua unduhan di daftar ini (klik lagi untuk membatalkan)
strings.Download files from a website section: Unduh file dari bagian situs web
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Klik Tambah URL, tempel tautan, letakkan tautan di jendela ini, atau unduh dari browser dengan ekstensi.
strings.Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…: Hapus dan Pindahkan File ke Recycle Bin…
strings.Delete and Move File to Trash…: Hapus dan Pindahkan File ke Tong Sampah…
strings.The new language is used after the app r: Bahasa baru dipakai setelah aplikasi dimulai ulang.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Unduhan, video, dan torrent hanya memakai adaptor ini (misalnya VPN Anda). Jika terputus, unduhan berhenti alih-alih memakai koneksi lain.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Daftar blokir torrent: file atau alamat https:// (kosong = tidak ada)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Torrent tidak pernah terhubung ke alamat dalam daftar ini. Daftar P2P, DAT, dan CIDR bisa dipakai, juga dalam .gz. Alamat diunduh ulang sekali sehari.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: Alamat daftar blokir harus diawali https://
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Item baru dari feed ini diunduh jika judulnya cocok dengan aturan: file dan video, serta torrent jika torrent aktif. Aturan berisi kata yang semuanya harus ada di judul, atau /ekspresi reguler/.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Unduh item yang judulnya berisi semua kata ini (kosong = semua)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Lewati item yang judulnya berisi salah satu kata ini
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Hanya unduh item yang muncul setelah feed ditambahkan
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Alamat feed harus diawali http:// atau https://
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Saat saya memakai komputer, batasi unduhan ke KB/s (0 = mati)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Kecepatan penuh lagi setelah satu menit tanpa keyboard atau mouse.
strings.Your API key for the service: Kunci API Anda untuk layanan ini
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Situs yang tautannya lewat layanan ini (pisahkan dengan koma, mis. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Mati secara default. Memakai akun Anda sendiri; tautan dari situs lain tidak pernah dikirim ke layanan. Kunci disimpan terenkripsi dan tidak pernah masuk cadangan.
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Download limit: at most this many MB (0 = no limit)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: When the amount is reached, downloads stop and continue by themselves when the next period starts.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Enter the proxy script's web address (http:// or https://) or the full path of the file.
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Proxy address (for a proxy script: its web address or file)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Put each package in its own folder
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Unpack a package's archives when all of it is done
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Paste text with links, or a web page address and press Find Links. Parts of a split archive are grouped into one package.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Save the whole gallery with the gallery engine (sites like Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; the engine is downloaded the first time)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Start the Add window in the folder I used last time
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Wake the computer from sleep to start
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options must allow wake timers. The app has to be running (it can be in the tray).
strings.Getting the gallery engine (only the fir: Getting the gallery engine (only the first time)…
strings.Getting the video engine (only the first: Getting the video engine (only the first time)…
